result.title: PathXAI: Evidence-guided structured pathology reporting by transferable tissue segmentation
result.comment: More experimental results will be added in the future version
result.summary: Pathology reporting requires translating tissue observations across regions and slides into specific diagnoses and supporting morphological descriptions. However, the use of explicit tissue-composition measurements to guide H&E-based report generation remains underexplored. Thus, we developed PathXAI, which combines segmentation-derived tissue information with H&E images and optional domain knowledge to guide diagnostic reasoning, targeted reinspection and structured report writing. Its segmentation component exceeded baselines in mean Dice on internal and external tests. In automated report evaluation on 1,200 public and 151 private cases, PathXAI achieved higher agreement with reference diagnoses and documented morphology than the H&E-based comparators. On the public evaluation cohort, PathXAI-Report exceeded Qwen + H&E in cancer family match rate by 4.4 percentage points and in finding F1 by 5.7 percentage points. PathXAI generates evidence-linked reports with a self-hosted pretrained vision-language model, without updating its weights.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PathXAI，将分割得到的组织成分信息与 H&E 图像、可选领域知识一起输入自托管预训练 VLM（不更新权重），引导诊断推理、针对性复检与结构化病理报告生成，并在内部与外部数据上评估分割 Dice 及报告与参考诊断、形态描述的一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 把显式组织成分测量作为可核查的证据通道注入冻结 VLM，并生成证据链接的报告，可供核查视觉证据筛选与「证据—结论」对应关系；但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态生成或动态计算分配，迁移价值需读原文确认。
